text:
Deploy Bot: rollout r-2026-03-15T21Z started to 10% in us-west-2, variant=v3-quant.
Marcus L: seeing synthetic probe divergence between shadow and live routes, small but consistent p95 delta (~120ms).
Anya P: can you paste the probe IDs? I want to check sampling keys.
Marcus L: probe ids: smoke/kv-prefill-013, smoke/embed-short-21. Shadow samples show a higher entropy on token sampler, looks like different seed.
SRE Oncall: deploybot telemetry shows fewer probe events from the synthetic scheduler for ~5m starting at 3265432220.
Jordan: is that the scheduler or the probe agent? Could be rate-limited on the shadow path.
Marcus L: quick grep from the agent logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:07:03Z agent: sample_seed=0x7a1f3b
2026-03-15T21:07:04Z agent: sample_seed=0x2b9d00  # shadow
2026-03-15T21:10:30Z synth-sender: dropped 8 events (backpressure)
```
Marta: dropped events would skew coverage and lead to sampling entropy mismatch, yep.
Anya P: impact? User-facing latencies ok so far, but synthetic drift might hide regressions if left unchecked.
Marcus L: p95 live route +60ms vs baseline, shadow +180ms. So shadow worse — likely prefill warmup not running on shadow nodes.
SRE Oncall: I can check prefill warmup logs on the shadow fleet. Assigning to me now.
Deploy Bot: note: r-2026-03-15T21Z pinned canary window 10m, auto-rollback in 30m unless manual override.
Jordan: recommendation: pause further rollout and pin variant=v2-quant for remaining 90% until we confirm shadow warmup parity.
Marta: +1 to pause. If prefill/KV warmup isn't firing on shadow, we need to either enable warmup or adjust sampling to tolerate seed differences.
Anya P: temporary mitigation: increase synth sampling frequency for live routes to 2x for 10m so we get more signal while we triage.
Marcus L: done: bumped synth sampling for live and shadow to 2x at 3265432300.
SRE Oncall: checking warmup logs now — seeing missing prefill trigger on shadow controller; root cause: controller's feature flag rollout missed shadow cluster namespace.
Marta: that explains it. Plan: re-enable flag in shadow namespace, trigger prefill warmup, and re-run targeted synth set.
Jordan: timeline? If it's a quick flag flip, we can unpause rollout in 15m.
SRE Oncall: flag flip done at 3265432400, prefill jobs enqueued. I'll watch p95 over the next 5m.
Marcus L: observed p95 for shadow dropping toward live baseline at 3265432460, gap closing.
Anya P: decision: keep main rollout paused (no further ramp) for 15m hold to confirm parity, then continue to 50% if stable. No rollback.
Deploy Bot: rollout paused by humans at 3265432410, canary remains at 10%.
Marta: filing a brief incident note and tweak to the deploy checklist to ensure the prefill feature-flag coverage includes shadow namespaces.
Jordan: follow-up: add an automated smoke comparison metric (shadow vs live p95 ratio) to the deploy gate so we get a hard threshold next time.
SRE Oncall: will open PR for gate metric and add a small runbook entry.
Marcus L: thanks — I'll keep monitoring and post a quick debrief when we resume.
Anya P: :thumbsup:
